type Id = `id-${number}`;
const id: Id = "id-1";
const k2: `id-${number}` = `${id}`;
function cell(r: number, c: number): `${number},${number}` {
  return `${r},${c}`;
}
const label: `cell(${number},${number})` = `cell(${cell(1, 2)})`;
const k4: `user:id-${number}` = `user:${id}`;
const k5 = "id-3" as `${Id}`;
const k6: Id = k5;
console.log(k2, label, k4, k6);

type A = `${"a"}${number}`;
const a: A = "a1";
const a2: `a${number}` = a;
type B = `x${`${"p" | "q"}-${number}`}y`;
const b: B = "xp-1y";
const b2: `x${string}y` = b;
type W<T extends string> = `${`<${T}>`}!`;
const w: W<"k"> = "<k>!";
type IsA = `${`a${string}`}` extends `a${string}` ? "yes" : "no";
const isA: IsA = "yes";
type K = keyof { [k: `${`on${string}`}`]: 1 };
const key: K = "onX";
const spelled: `${true}-${null}-${undefined}-${1n}` = "true-null-undefined-1";
console.log(a, a2, b, b2, w, isA, key, spelled);

type Upper = `${Uppercase<string>}`;
const upper: Uppercase<string> = "AB" as Uppercase<string>;
const upper2: Upper = upper;
const upper3: Uppercase<string> = upper2;
console.log(upper, upper2, upper3);
